canDoYue: 你識按克問金價，秤一隻九九九金手鐲，問手工費，用舊鏈換購，同埋喺收據睇重量同純度。
canDoEn: Ask the gold price per gram, weigh a nine-nine-nine bangle, ask the labour charge, trade in an old chain, and read the weight and purity on the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Hi. What's your gold price per gram for this bangle?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。呢隻手鐲一克金係幾多錢？
dialogue.say: Hi. What's your gold price per gram for this bangle?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: This bangle is nine nine nine. I will weigh it in grams.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢隻手鐲係九九九金。我用克嚟秤。
dialogue.say: This bangle is nine nine nine. I will weigh it in grams.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: The clasp is broken. How much is the labour charge?
dialogue.glossYue: 個扣壞咗。手工費係幾多？
dialogue.say: The clasp is broken. How much is the labour charge?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The labour charge is forty dollars on top of the gold.
dialogue.glossYue: 手工費係四十蚊，金價另外計。
dialogue.say: The labour charge is forty dollars on top of the gold.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can I trade in this old chain against the new bangle?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以用呢條舊鏈換購新手鐲？
dialogue.say: Can I trade in this old chain against the new bangle?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. I can trade that chain and note it on the receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。呢條鏈可以換購，我會寫低喺收據。
dialogue.say: Yes. I can trade that chain and note it on the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Will my receipt also show the weight and the purity?
dialogue.glossYue: 收據會唔會同時寫重量同純度？
dialogue.say: Will my receipt also show the weight and the purity?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. Your receipt shows the weight, the purity, and the full price.
dialogue.glossYue: 會。收據寫重量、純度同埋個價錢。
dialogue.say: Yes. Your receipt shows the weight, the purity, and the full price.
